strategy_roster.name: Blau Ergodic
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26) zero-line direction is a fallback for the Blau momentum oscillator's Breakdown mode. Triple EMA smoothing, Twist/CloudTwist modes, SignalBar, and point-based protection are not directly expressible.

strategy_roster.name: ColorMETRO WPR
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(7) versus its five-period smoother approximates the fast/slow Williams-%R step lines and retains the documented cross direction. The explicit 2% stop and 4% target are retained; ColorMETRO construction and the short branch are simplified.

strategy_roster.name: Ultimate Strategy Template
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(9)/SMA(21) crossover and inverse exit are exact. The optional 1% stop and 3% take-profit are retained, while the short side and template settings are not added to this long-only roster.

strategy_roster.name: FmOne Scalping
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9)/EMA(21) and MACD(12,26,9) crossovers retain the documented fast/slow momentum combination. Parameter names have no values, and trailing-stop, percent protection, and exact MACD signal settings are not supplied.

strategy_roster.name: MA SAR ADX
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,100) and adx(high,low,close,14) > 20 and roc(close,5) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(100), ADX(14), and positive ROC(5) approximate the moving-average, DI-strength, and SAR-direction conditions. Parabolic SAR, +DI/-DI lines, and SAR exits are unavailable; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: PSAR Multi Timeframe
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20)/EMA(50) and ROC(5) provide a directional proxy for the three-timeframe Parabolic SAR filter. M15/M30/H1 streams, SAR state, money management, and point offsets are not expressible in the single-series DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Visible Chart
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar prior high break and opposite low break approximate the visible Highest/Lowest range; 20 is an explicit fallback because no lookback is supplied. The configurable length and opposite-signal permissions are otherwise retained in long-only form.

strategy_roster.name: DiNapoli Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) versus a six-period smoother approximates the Stochastic %K/%D relationship and follows the documented long cross direction. FastK/SlowK/SlowD, permission flags, and exact DiNapoli smoothing are not directly available.

strategy_roster.name: Trading Panel Batch
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy fires an operator-selected batch rather than deriving a market signal, so the impossible guard avoids fabricating entries. Panel state, direction reset, pip protection, and order batching are outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: JMaster RSX
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing the documented 25 oversold level with a bullish SMA(30)/SMA(50) regime approximates Jurik RSX confirmation. The fast/slow RSX streams, midline calculation, and exact delayed-bar execution are not available.
